title: Feature Request: Support exponential backoff in worker retry strategy
body:
Currently workers retry on failure with a fixed 1000ms delay. We need configurable exponential backoff with jitter so external API rate limits are respected during burst operations.

Proposed API:
```ts
retryPolicy: {
  initialIntervalMs: 500,
  backoffCoefficient: 2.0,
  maximumIntervalMs: 30000,
  jitter: true
}
```
